title: Galaxy spin handedness: a mirror test before the result

sentences.text: Galaxy spin handedness: a mirror test before the result.
sentences.visual_action: Title resolves over a moving field of paired spiral glyphs.

sentences.text: Can an apparent imbalance between clockwise and anticlockwise labels be separated from one introduced by the labeling process?
sentences.visual_action: Two label populations balance, then route through a highlighted HUMAN LABELING node.

sentences.text: Counting alone cannot decide, because every count passes through that process.
sentences.visual_action: A raw counter advances but a lock appears after the labeling node.

sentences.text: Mirror one conceptual spiral: the image flips, and its apparent label inverts.
sentences.visual_action: One spiral crosses a vertical mirror plane with continuous horizontal inversion; label morphs clockwise to anticlockwise.

sentences.text: An image-linked pattern must invert; a labeling-process effect need not.
sentences.visual_action: The transformed object feeds two causal branches, must invert versus need not invert.

sentences.text: That discriminating logic was frozen before the analysis result was read.
sentences.visual_action: Contract brackets close around MIRROR, THRESHOLDS, and PAIRED COMPARISON.

sentences.text: The frozen Galaxy Zoo 1 source contains 667,944 rows.
sentences.visual_action: Row particles stream into a Galaxy Zoo 1 data release, Table 2 reservoir with the count attached.

sentences.text: Three readouts run from it in parallel: the spiral flag, a zero point six threshold, and a zero point eight threshold.
sentences.visual_action: The source reservoir splits into three parallel labeled branches.

sentences.text: The flag retains 190,225 rows, split into 161,172 decisive labels and 29,053 ties.
sentences.visual_action: The flag branch counter resolves, then separates into decisive and tie substreams with parent conservation.

sentences.text: The thresholds retain 51,157 and 30,412 decisively labeled rows.
sentences.visual_action: The 0.60 and 0.80 branch counters reveal on one shared rows baseline.

sentences.text: Within one readout, N C W and N A C W count the two labels.
sentences.visual_action: N_CW and N_ACW chips detach from the selected readout and enter the formula workspace.

sentences.text: Their difference is the numerator, and their total is the denominator.
sentences.visual_action: N_CW minus N_ACW constructs above a fraction bar; N_CW plus N_ACW constructs below it.

sentences.text: The sign would indicate which label is more numerous, but the predeclared asymmetry value remains withheld.
sentences.visual_action: A symmetric, unselected sign rail appears; the equation completes and a physical value lock closes.

sentences.text: Mirrored images, both thresholds, and paired same-object comparisons form the control design.
sentences.visual_action: Three matrix rows reveal: mirror, thresholds, paired object.

sentences.text: They test label inversion, threshold sensitivity, and individual change versus sample composition; this matrix shows design, not outcomes.
sentences.visual_action: Each control connects to its tested failure mode; DESIGN ONLY banner wipes across.

sentences.text: The source and method are frozen.
sentences.visual_action: SOURCE FREEZE and METHOD FREEZE timeline nodes illuminate green.

sentences.text: The stored-direction convention remains unresolved, and the independent post-run verdict record is absent.
sentences.visual_action: A timeline pulse reaches amber FRAME and VERDICT RECORD nodes and stops.

sentences.text: Evidence, receipt, and referee stages also remain open, so result rendering is locked.
sentences.visual_action: Three open review nodes reveal; a red lock closes on RESULT RENDER.

sentences.text: Known now are the sample, estimator, mirror logic, and controls; no result value, direction, or interpretation is reportable.
sentences.visual_action: KNOWN and NOT REPORTABLE boundary columns build from the persistent timeline.

sentences.text: The next review gate is the independent post-run verdict record, while the stored-direction frame must also be resolved before this question can be answered.
sentences.visual_action: NEXT GATE column reveals, then an arrow reconnects to the opening question without showing an answer.
